The '''ravenbeast''' was a predatory species native to the [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]] of [[Seregar]]. It was a large biped, with [[Color/Legends|violet]] fur and horns. It had large curling claws and clear fangs which were used to attack prey. The claws and fangs were worth about 1,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] in [[Storrd Township]].
